title: Reference images are easier to add in Play
summary:
Reference images got easier to upload, Qwen3.5 joined the model list, and Model Monitor learned to watch audio and video too.

Play added click-to-browse and drag-and-drop reference-image uploads, with progress and error feedback. The homepage now gives a clearer overview of available capabilities, while model links retain their destination through sign-in.

Qwen3.5 397B A17B was added as `qwen`, with image inputs, tools, reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. Related model work corrected the Suno music-generation route and added a proxy route for qwen3-tts requests.

Model Monitor now includes audio models and identifies video models by their output modality. It also separates models by endpoint, makes degraded and off states easier to spot, and puts models without data at the bottom of the table.

highlights.title: Drop images into Play
highlights.text: Add reference images by browsing or dragging files into Play, with upload progress and errors shown there. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Qwen3.5 397B joins
highlights.text: Use `qwen` for text and image inputs, tools, and reasoning, with a 262,144-token context window. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen).

highlights.title: Monitor audio and video models
highlights.text: Model Monitor now includes audio and video models alongside text and image models, with clearer indicators for degraded or off states. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
